facts.business: Rajasthan Cylinders and Containers Limited has closed its manufacturing operations and disposed of plant and machinery, with the board appointing a consultant for a new project.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: (i) interest payable under MSMED Act not ascertained/provided; (ii) balances of trade payables, financial assets, advances, loans subject to confirmation; (iii) loans & advances of Rs. 230.50 Lakhs receivable from related parties without agreement/repayment terms, recoverability uncertain; (iv) deferred tax assets of Rs. 650.76 Lakhs recognized despite history of losses and no operational segment. Material uncertainty related to going concern due to closure of manufacturing operations and disposal of plant & machinery.

key_risks: Company has closed manufacturing operations and disposed of plant & machinery
Material uncertainty related to going concern
History of losses and no operational segment
Uncertain recoverability of related party loans & advances (Rs. 230.50 Lakhs)
Deferred tax assets recognition uncertain due to loss history
Balances subject to confirmation and consequential adjustments
Interest payable under MSMED Act not ascertained or provided for
facts.related_party_note: Loans & Advances includes Rs. 230.50 Lakhs receivable from related parties of the company. In absence of any agreement and repayment terms, auditor unable to comment on recoverability.
